description: This file contains a PHP trait 'LeaveRequestPermissionTrait' which provides permission checking functionalities related to leave requests within the OrangeHRM system. It uses other traits and classes to verify user roles and access permissions for leave requests.

methods.name: checkLeaveRequestAccessible
methods.description: Checks if a leave request is accessible for the current user based on their permissions and roles. Throws exceptions if access is not permitted or if the context is invalid.
